expectations.text: States the October 1, 2026 omnibus proposed rule would remove and reserve VIII(h)(10)
expectations.evidence: "91 FR 62361, published October 1, 2026" ... "It proposes removing VIII(h)(10), which would move most radar altimeters off the USML."

expectations.text: Makes clear nothing has changed yet: the items remain ITAR-controlled while the rule is at proposal stage
expectations.evidence: "nothing has changed yet. The removal of USML VIII(h)(10) is a PROPOSAL, not a final rule. Until a final rule issues, your civil radar altimeters caught by VIII(h)(10) stay ITAR-controlled."

expectations.text: States the comment deadline: November 30, 2026 (docket DOS-2026-0991)
Explains that if finalized, the items would transition out of the USML (to EAR jurisdiction) and the final rule's terms should be monitored
expectations.evidence: "would move most radar altimeters off the USML. Presumably they would fall under Commerce (EAR) jurisdiction. The destination classification and any retained exceptions should be confirmed in the final text."

expectations.text: Advises maintaining ITAR compliance in the interim and considering a comment submission
expectations.evidence: "Keep treating the altimeters, their technical data and software as ITAR-controlled" and "Consider commenting by November 30, 2026."
